name: system_invoice_has_single_balanced_posted_journal
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.system_invoice_has_single_balanced_posted_journal(p_company_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid, p_expected_amount numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    count(*) = 1
    AND bool_and(
      lower(COALESCE(entry.status, '')) = 'posted'
      AND abs(COALESCE(entry.total_debit, 0) - p_expected_amount) <= 0.01
      AND abs(COALESCE(entry.total_credit, 0) - p_expected_amount) <= 0.01
      AND (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM public.journal_entry_lines line
        WHERE line.journal_entry_id = entry.id
      ) >= 2
      AND abs(
        COALESCE((
          SELECT sum(COALESCE(line.debit_amount, 0))
          FROM public.journal_entry_lines line
          WHERE line.journal_entry_id = entry.id
        ), 0) - p_expected_amount
      ) <= 0.01
      AND abs(
        COALESCE((
          SELECT sum(COALESCE(line.credit_amount, 0))
          FROM public.journal_entry_lines line
          WHERE line.journal_entry_id = entry.id
        ), 0) - p_expected_amount
      ) <= 0.01
    ),
    false
  )
  FROM public.journal_entries entry
  WHERE entry.company_id = p_company_id
    AND entry.reference_type = 'invoice'
    AND entry.reference_id = p_invoice_id;
$function$
